name: Upload videos (batch)
description: Uploads multiple videos to TikTok concurrently, either to the creator's inbox as drafts or using the direct publishing flow. Returns per-file upload results; direct publication status can be checked using the returned publish IDs.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption/title used when publish=true. Max 2200 UTF-16 runes.

is_aigc.title: Is Aigc
is_aigc.description: Set true to label the videos as AI-generated content.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: If true, attempts to publish after each upload using direct publish flow.

disable_duet.title: Disable Duet
disable_duet.description: Whether to disable duets on the videos.

privacy_level.title: PrivacyLevel
privacy_level.description:
Privacy levels accepted by TikTok's Content Posting API.

The valid set for a given account is only discoverable via
``/v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/``. For unaudited apps only
``SELF_ONLY`` is permitted.

https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-direct-post

disable_stitch.title: Disable Stitch
disable_stitch.description: Whether to disable stitches on the videos.

disable_comment.title: Disable Comment
disable_comment.description: Whether to disable comments on the videos.

name.title: Name
name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.title: S3Key
s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

files_to_upload.title: Files To Upload
files_to_upload.description: List of video files to upload to TikTok in parallel (at least one). Files are uploaded whole when possible and split into sequential TikTok-compatible chunks for larger videos. Supports common video formats like MP4, MOV, WebM. Too-long or unsupported-codec files are rejected. Caption (via `caption`) must also be within TikTok's length limit.

chunk_size_bytes.title: Chunk Size Bytes
chunk_size_bytes.description: Optional chunk size for multipart uploads. Must be between 5,000,000 and 64,000,000 bytes and must produce a valid TikTok upload plan for every file. Omit this to choose a safe chunk size automatically.

brand_content_toggle.title: Brand Content Toggle
brand_content_toggle.description: Set true if the content is a paid partnership promoting a third-party business.

brand_organic_toggle.title: Brand Organic Toggle
brand_organic_toggle.description: Set true if the content promotes the creator's own business.

video_cover_timestamp_ms.title: Video Cover Timestamp Ms
video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to use as video cover/thumbnail.

TikTokError.title: TikTokError

code.title: Code
code.description: Status indicator; 'ok' indicates success, other values indicate specific error types (e.g., 'invalid_param', 'access_token_invalid', 'scope_not_authorized', 'rate_limit_exceeded').

log_id.title: Log Id
log_id.description: Unique execution identifier for tracking the request.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable error description. Empty string when successful.

TikTokError.description: Error information returned by TikTok API

BatchItemResult.title: BatchItemResult

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if the upload failed

publish_id.title: Publish Id
publish_id.description: An identifier to track the posting action, which you can use to check the status. Maximum length: 64 characters.

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: The URL provided by TikTok where the video file can be uploaded. Maximum length: 256 characters. Only present when source is FILE_UPLOAD. Valid for one hour after issuance.

tiktok_error.title: Tiktok Error
tiktok_error.description: Structured error response from TikTok API if available

publish_response.title: Publish Response
publish_response.description: Raw JSON publish response if publish=true

upload_status_code.title: Upload Status Code
upload_status_code.description: HTTP status code from upload PUT request

BatchItemResult.description: Result of uploading a single video file in the batch operation

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
